description.fun: Regice is made of ice from the ice age, shaped by Regigigas according to legend, and it's said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. It wraps itself in air at −200 °C that freezes anything nearby solid, and its body can't be melted, not even in molten lava. Like the other giants, it was sealed away by ancient people who feared its power.
description.guide: An Ice-type Legendary Pokémon, one of the legendary giants, said to have been made by Regigigas from ice-age ice. It floats and freezes everything around it. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A giant of ice-age ice that even lava can't melt
